title: Automated benthic detection and identification of key marine features through machine learning and machine vision prototypes
desc: The AMBULANT prototype: neural-network pipelines trained on annotated ROV stills to recognise benthic features, presented as a route to routine, non-expert habitat monitoring.
authors: Boujmil, I., Karovic, S., Zama, F., __Olatoye, D. S.__, Klenczner, T. A., Siciliano, A., Dimech, S., Sitilo, N., Sacco, O., Pierucci, M., Deguara, D., Scerri, D., Theuma, L. & Paolacci, S.
